decisions.reason: After several years on the market, this close-to-core multi-variant supplement line is likely meeting or exceeding aspiration levels, so in an expanding firm with slack it is worth retaining.
This consumer-health supplement fits the firm's portfolio-broadening strategy and its continued presence suggests performance is sufficiently near aspiration to justify keeping it.
Although still more niche and less visible than the main supplement lines, its survival indicates acceptable results and the firm can continue to carry it while monitoring demand.

The earlier problem signal and tougher generic-drug economics keep withdrawal risk elevated, but surviving several years implies the product has likely recovered to a level close enough to aspiration to retain for now.

As a newer OTC medicine that supports the firm's expansion in prescription and consumer-health products, it would usually be kept unless results clearly fell below aspiration, which is not evident here.
